playbook: the article editor is https://editor.csdn.net/md/ (Markdown): ONE action=publish with title=, body= in Markdown (## headings, a blank line between paragraphs) and files=[pictures]; publish writes the Markdown, pastes the pictures one at a time (CSDN uploads each and writes its own ![](https://i-blog.csdnimg.cn/...) link; SVG files are converted to PNG), fills the 发布文章 panel (tags) and confirms
do not use the rich editor https://mp.csdn.net/mp_blog/creation/editor: publish always opens the Markdown editor
the title is the input at the top (placeholder 请输入文章标题（5～100个字）); a title shorter than 5 characters is refused by CSDN

it is published only when the page becomes https://mp.csdn.net/mp_blog/creation/success/<id> (public link https://blog.csdn.net/<account>/article/details/<id>); 审核中 means submitted and under review, not yet public
after a failed publish call the page is /md?articleId=N (a saved draft): call publish again on that same page, never open a second editor
